roadmap.out_of_scope: No change to the GithubPort contract (ADR-019 §1), the verbs' output text, token handling, or the 401 TokenRejected path. Whitespace-only tokens stay as they are. No push until the user says so.

phases.name: The auth report comes from GitHub's rate-limit headers

steps.name: Header-based auth report; the note stays quiet with a token
steps.description: crates/adapter-github/src/client.rs: add a pure function (e.g. auth_report_of(token_configured: bool, limit: Option<&str>, remaining: Option<&str>) -> AuthReport) returning Authenticated { remaining, limit } only when a token was configured and both header values parse, otherwise Anonymous. Remove parse_auth_report and its tests that lock in the body shape. crates/adapter-github/src/lib.rs: in send_get_once (about :637-666), on a 200 that carries both x-ratelimit-limit and x-ratelimit-remaining, record_auth_report(auth_report_of(self.auth.is_authenticated(), ...)); a response without both headers does not overwrite an earlier report. Remove the four body-based record_auth_report calls (about :286, :313, :405, :556). crates/test-support/src/fake_github.rs: when its posture is authenticated (remaining, limit) and the request carried the token, send X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining on every 200, including the person profile and owned-repos responses; the anonymous posture sends limit 60 (and its remaining); drop the "auth" body key (about :1491-1506). Update any fake fixture or test that relied on the body key. The verbs (scrape_person.rs, scrape_github.rs) do not change.
criteria: New acceptance test in tests/acceptance/scrape_person_command.rs next to scrape_person_warns_about_the_unauthenticated_rate_limit: scrape person against an authenticated fake with GITHUB_TOKEN set (the token helper used by tests/acceptance/scrape_auth.rs) exits 0, its stdout does not contain 'Note: without GITHUB_TOKEN', and it contains 'authenticated ('. It fails against today's code: record the RED.

Adapter test (replacing the body-shaped test at crates/adapter-github/src/lib.rs about :1256): an adapter built with a token, served a real-shaped /users/{u} body with no auth key plus X-RateLimit-Limit: 5000 and X-RateLimit-Remaining: 4982, reports Authenticated { remaining: 4982, limit: 5000 }; without a token, or without the headers, it reports Anonymous.
Proptest for the pure function: Authenticated only when token_configured and both values parse as numbers, with exactly those numbers; Anonymous otherwise.
scrape_person_warns_about_the_unauthenticated_rate_limit, SA-1 (tests/acceptance/scrape_auth.rs) and every other scrape_* and adapter-github test pass; the no-token-leak checks still pass.
